'''Phillip "PM" Michaels''' is, in [[1992]], the DJ of the [[CSR 103.9]] radio station in [[Grand Theft Auto: San Andreas]].

== Description ==
Michaels is an extremely self-obsessed character who believes that he is the next big star, despite his entertainment career having very limited success. Michaels also exhibits a degree of sexism, often treating women as no more than items.

Philip Michaels is voiced by Michael Bivins, a a prominent member of the boy band [[:wp:New Edition|New Edition]], its branchoff group [[:wp:Bell Biv DeVoe|Bell Biv DeVoe]], and a producer for [[:wp:Boyz II Men|Boyz II Men]] - all groups and singers that make up the majority of CSR 103.9's playlist. Philip says he was almost in Bell Biv DeVoe, but was kicked out because he wanted to name the band only after himself.
